Figure 1:GEPA-Curator system diagram.
The prompt optimizer takes in a minibatch of tasks at each iteration and invokes the actor agent to execute them and performs reflective prompt optimization based on the resulting trajectories.
The Curator augments the prompt optimizer by acting as an outer-loop process which traverses through the training dataset and constructs each minibatch to pass into the prompt optimizer.
The Curator reads past execution trajectories for each task sampled from the training dataset and decides to run the task if doing so is likely to provide useful optimization signal (Section3.1).
The Curator can also pass prior successful trajectories for failed tasks as context to the prompt optimizer as a trusted reference example (Section3.2).
Once the curated training batch of selected tasks and successful context is constructed, it is passed to the prompt optimizer for execution and optimization.
The resulting trajectories and evaluation outcomes are then written back to the task history for use in subsequent curation rounds.
